description.value: Fort Langley Library is a public branch of the Fraser Valley Regional Library (FVRL) system, nestled in the heritage village of Fort Langley. The library is freely open to all and provides computers, printing, and a full lending collection. Its location in one of BC's most historically rich cycling destinations makes it a natural rest stop for riders passing through the area.
